title: ID0385055-DC/Si-D/DE[jlxdQi] - EVSE not upscalling
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
After EV reaches 80% SoC, it decreases the EV_TarCur from 216A to 94A for battery balancing (new function), and when it's finished (~1min), it wants to increase the EV_TarCur but the charger doesn't respond to the need because Upscalling is not included yet.
Root cause:
FW issue
Solution:
Planned in v6.2.X
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active
https://jira.si.siemens.cloud/browse/EVC3-6896
→ R&D Jira ticket
Update from R&D 22/Oct/2024:
Upscaling is part of DPA improvements which will come probably with FW v6.2.0. So it's on the roadmap but it will not be released sometime soon.
Update 21/Nov/2024:
Still to do, expected to be released in v5.2.X

Current Behaviour:
After the EV starts charging 09:05:04, it reaches the EVTarCur=216 after 50sec:
[ STATE - 2024-10-14T09:05:53.101Z ] <request> CurrentDemandReq#67 SessionID=15 EVTargetCurrent=216 EVTargetVoltage=714 EVMaximumCurrentLimit 330 EVMaximumVoltageLimit 750 EVMaximumPowerLimit 248000 ChargingComplete=0
And stays with the value until 09:33:37, where it starts decreasing the EV TarCur and reaches 94 A.
STATE - 2024-10-14T09:33:38.906Z ] <request> CurrentDemandReq#8138 SessionID=15 EVTargetCurrent=94 EVTargetVoltage=739 EVMaximumCurrentLimit 330 EVMaximumVoltageLimit 750 EVMaximumPowerLimit 248000 ChargingComplete=0
And stays in this EVTarCur value for approx. 40secs. After this, the EV starts requesting more current:
STATE - 2024-10-14T09:34:17.909Z ] <request> CurrentDemandReq#8327 SessionID=15 EVTargetCurrent=111 EVTargetVoltage=735 EVMaximumCurrentLimit 330 EVMaximumVoltageLimit 750 EVMaximumPowerLimit 248000 ChargingComplete=0
As we can see, it starts ramping up the current but it stays with EVSEMaximumCurrentLimit=111 and cannot go further as the charger limits the current to this value and doesn't upscale.
This way, the EV takes much longer to charge as it should. In this case, it would need to be replugged to charge at the right amount of current as requested.
Expected behaviour:
When battery balancing is completed, the charger is able to upscale which means that he is able to return to the 216 A EV_TarCur.
